title: Remote Code Execution in Apache Struts 2
remediation: Upgrade Apache Struts library to version 6.3.0.2 or higher

title: Spring Framework Path Traversal Vulnerability
remediation: Update Spring Boot framework dependencies to 3.2.2+

title: PostgreSQL Authentication Bypass via Insecure Pg_hba
remediation: Restrict pg_hba.conf client CIDR ranges and require scram-sha-256

title: OpenSSL TLS Session Renegotiation Weakness
remediation: Apply vendor firmware patch 4.2.1 on VPN concentrator

title: Kubernetes API Server Unauthorized Access Token Leak
remediation: Rotate cluster service account signing keys and restrict node auth

title: Missing Content-Security-Policy and Clickjacking
remediation: Configure strict CSP headers in NGINX ingress controller

title: Log4j Remote JNDI Injection Dependency Detected
remediation: Upgrade log4j-core to 2.17.1 across loan service microservices
